name: 生物
intro: 西幻生物多来自希腊罗马神话、中世纪动物寓言集（bestiary）与北欧凯尔特民间——全部公有领域。分三类：可缔结的伙伴与坐骑、需要讨伐的怪物、象征性的神话之兽。威胁按「讨伐等级」评定。

entries.name: 讨伐等级
entries.summary: 五级：害兽 Pest → 野兽 Beast → 怪物 Monster → 恐怖 Terror → 灾厄 Calamity。用于公会委托与王国警报，与灵魂金属位阶对照使用。

details.Pest 害兽: 凡人民兵可处理（巨鼠、鬼火）
details.Beast 野兽: 需锡阶战士小队（巨狼、狮鹫幼崽）
details.Monster 怪物: 需铜至铁阶（蛇怪、蝎尾狮）
details.Terror 恐怖: 需汞阶以上或军队（九头蛇、成年龙）
details.Calamity 灾厄: 威胁王国，需银阶以上（古龙、海妖王）

entries.visual: 公会告示上的骷髅数量或印章颜色。

image.brief: Five original monster-bounty wax seals pressed onto five small blank parchment slips in a row, increasing in size and menace from left to right: a small plain brown seal with a single claw mark, a green seal with two claw marks, a blue seal with three claw marks, a purple seal with four claw marks, and a large black-and-red seal with five claw marks around a cracked dragon eye.

subgroups.name: 伙伴与坐骑
subgroups.intro: 可经灵魂缔结（GR06）成为伙伴。

entries.name: 狮鹫
entries.summary: 鹰首狮身有翼的猛兽：守护黄金，骄傲、忠诚，一生只认一位骑手。骑士团的空中坐骑。

details.缔结: 需从蛋孵化或赢得其尊重

entries.visual: 金褐羽毛、鹰喙、狮身狮尾。

image.brief: A griffin standing in a three-quarter side view: the head, wings and front talons of a great golden eagle merged with the muscular body, hind legs and tufted tail of a tawny lion, wings half spread, a leather riding saddle on its back; it is the size of a large warhorse: the normal-size adult human silhouette beside it reaches its shoulder.

entries.name: 飞马
entries.summary: 白色有翼骏马：迅捷、纯洁、难以驯服。只接纳心地正直的骑手。

details.缔结: 需在其饮水时以金辔头套住（希腊传说）

entries.visual: 白马与天鹅般的大翅。

image.brief: A white winged horse in a three-quarter side view, the size of an ordinary riding horse, powerful and elegant, with enormous swan-like white feathered wings spread wide, a flowing silver-white mane, a simple gold bridle, one front hoof lifted; the normal-size adult human silhouette beside it is about as tall as the horse's back.

entries.name: 独角兽
entries.summary: 额生螺旋长角的白色神兽：角能解一切毒，只向纯洁之人低头。猎杀独角兽被视为最大的罪孽之一。
entries.visual: 比马纤细、山羊般的胡须与偶蹄，珍珠白长角。

image.brief: A unicorn standing in a three-quarter side view in the medieval bestiary style: a slender pure white horse-like body with cloven hooves, a small goat-like beard, a long silky mane, and a single long spiraled pearl-white horn on its forehead glowing faintly, calm noble posture; a small plain human silhouette stands beside it for scale.

entries.name: 恐狼
entries.summary: 体型如小马的巨狼：游侠与北方部族的伙伴，也是荒野中的猎手。与狼人不同，它们只是狼。
entries.visual: 灰黑厚毛、琥珀色眼。

image.brief: A great wolf the size of a small pony standing in a three-quarter side view, thick shaggy grey and black fur, amber eyes, a scarred muzzle, powerful shoulders, a simple leather collar with a bronze ring; a plain human silhouette stands right beside it for scale, and the wolf's shoulder reaches only the human's chest.

entries.name: 使魔
entries.summary: 女巫与法师的灵魂伙伴：黑猫、乌鸦、猫头鹰、蟾蜍、白鼬。能说话或传递感知，为主人侦察、看守、警告。

details.常见: 黑猫（女巫）、乌鸦（死灵/先知）、猫头鹰（法师）、蟾蜍（炼金）

entries.visual: 眼睛偶尔闪出与主人力量同色的光。

references.work: 近代早期英格兰猎巫记录

image.brief: Four familiar animals sitting in a row on a dark wooden beam, each with faintly glowing eyes of a different color: a sleek black cat with amber eyes, a large raven with pale teal eyes, a tawny owl with violet eyes, and a warty brown toad with green eyes; realistic animals, alert and intelligent.

entries.name: 魔像
entries.summary: 以泥土、石头或金属造出、以真名或符文驱动的仆从：力大无穷、绝对服从，抹去额上的字即停止。

details.驱动: 刻在额上或口中的符文/真名

entries.visual: 粗笨的人形，额头一枚发光刻印。

references.note: 以文字驱动的泥人（本库只用符文意象，不用宗教文字）

image.brief: A stone golem standing in a three-quarter side view, built of rough-hewn grey granite blocks joined with bands of dark bronze, a heavy blocky head with a single carved abstract sigil glowing molten gold in its forehead, cracks glowing faintly; a plain human silhouette stands right next to it for scale, and the golem is exactly about twice the human's height (about three meters tall).

entries.name: 龙
entries.summary: 见种族「龙」。作为生物形态：四足双翼、喷吐元素之息，是最高讨伐等级的存在。

xianxia.note: 西方龙四足双翼、喷火、守宝；中国龙无翼、司雨、祥瑞。

entries.visual: 四足双翼、长颈长尾、熔金竖瞳、鳞甲。

references.note: 法夫纳、贝奥武夫之龙、圣乔治屠龙

image.brief: A great western dragon in a three-quarter side view, four powerful legs and a separate pair of vast leathery bat-like wings half spread, a long neck and long tail, armored overlapping scales of dark bronze and deep red, a horned head with molten gold slit-pupil eyes, faint smoke curling from its nostrils, perched on rocky ground; a small plain human silhouette stands at its feet for scale.

entries.name: 双足飞龙
entries.summary: 两足有翼、尾带毒刺的龙类：比真龙小、无智慧、不喷火，但凶猛群居。常被驯为战兽。
entries.visual: 翼即前肢、两足、尾端毒刺。

image.brief: A wyvern in a three-quarter side view: a lean dragon-like beast standing on only two powerful hind legs with its wings forming its front limbs, mottled green-grey scales, a narrow toothy head, a long whip-like tail ending in a curved venomous stinger; a small plain human silhouette stands at its feet for scale.

entries.name: 凤凰
entries.summary: 浴火重生之鸟：寿终时自焚，从灰烬中重生。眼泪能治愈，羽毛永燃不熄。

xianxia.note: 西方凤凰核心是死而复生，单只、永生循环。

entries.visual: 赤金火焰般的长尾鸟。

image.brief: A phoenix perched on a charred branch in a three-quarter side view, an eagle-sized bird about one meter long with brilliant crimson, orange and gold plumage whose long tail feathers trail into real flickering flames, glowing ember-like eyes, a few sparks drifting upward; a plain human silhouette stands right beside the branch for scale, clearly much taller than the bird (the bird is about the size of the human's torso).

entries.name: 蛇怪
entries.summary: 「蛇中之王」：目光与气息致命，所经之处草木枯死。镜子与鼬鼠是它的克星。

details.克制: 镜子反射其目光、鼬鼠、公鸡啼声

entries.visual: 头顶冠状鳞片的巨蛇，眼睛发出致命的黄光。

references.work: 老普林尼《博物志》与中世纪寓言集

image.brief: A basilisk in a three-quarter side view: a serpent about six meters long raised in a coiled striking pose, olive and black scales, a small crown-like crest of pale bony spines on its head, sickly glowing yellow eyes, the grass beneath its coils withered and grey; its raised head is at the same height as the head of the normal-size adult human silhouette standing nearby.

entries.name: 九头蛇
entries.summary: 多头的沼泽巨蛇：砍下一个头会长出两个，必须以火灼烧断颈。毒血可淬兵器。
entries.visual: 粗壮的蛇身上分出多条长颈与蛇头。

image.brief: A hydra rising from a dark swamp in a three-quarter side view, a massive scaly serpentine body with seven long writhing necks each ending in a fanged serpent head, dark green and black scales, one neck stump cauterized and smoking; a small plain human silhouette stands at the water's edge for scale.

entries.name: 蝎尾狮
entries.summary: 人脸狮身、尾如蝎子能射出毒刺的食人兽。
entries.visual: 红狮身、三排牙的人形脸、蝎尾。

references.work: 克特西亚斯与中世纪寓言集

image.brief: A manticore in a three-quarter side view: the muscular body of a red-maned lion, an unsettling human-like face with a wide mouth showing rows of sharp teeth, and a long segmented scorpion tail arched over its back tipped with a cluster of spines; a small plain human silhouette stands nearby for scale.

entries.name: 海妖克拉肯
entries.summary: 北海深处的巨型章鱼/乌贼：能拖沉整艘船，浮上时被误认为岛屿。
entries.visual: 从海中升起的巨大触手缠住帆船。

image.brief: A stormy grey northern sea at dusk, a three-masted wooden sailing ship tilting sharply as several colossal dark red suckered tentacles rise from the waves and wrap around its hull and masts, a vast shadowy shape beneath the water, spray and lightning in the distance, tiny sailors visible on deck for scale.

entries.name: 石像鬼
entries.summary: 教堂屋檐上的石雕怪兽，夜里会活过来守护（或袭击）。白天变回石头，几乎不可破坏。
entries.visual: 蝠翼、利爪、风化石质的蹲坐怪兽。

image.brief: A gargoyle crouched on a gothic stone ledge in a three-quarter side view, a winged demonic creature carved of weathered grey stone with lichen stains, bat-like wings folded, clawed hands gripping the ledge, horned head with a snarling open mouth, its eyes glowing faintly as if just awakening, small cracks of stone flaking off as it moves; a small plain human silhouette below for scale.

entries.name: 地狱犬
entries.summary: 燃着地狱火的黑色巨犬：恶魔的猎犬，追踪灵魂契约到期者。英格兰民间的「黑犬」预示死亡。

details.规则: 追踪契约到期者，无法被常规手段甩掉

entries.visual: 煤黑巨犬，眼与口中燃火。

image.brief: A hellhound in a three-quarter side view: a huge coal-black mastiff-like hound with a lean ridged spine, glowing molten-orange eyes, embers and flames flickering from its mouth and along cracks in its skin, smoke rising from its fur, scorch marks on the ground at its paws; a small plain human silhouette stands nearby for scale.

entries.name: 报丧女妖
entries.summary: 爱尔兰传说中的女妖：她的哭嚎预示家中有人将死。本库定为亡灵/妖精之间的存在，哭声能震碎玻璃与理智。
entries.visual: 苍白长发、灰白衣、半透明，张口哭嚎。

image.brief: A banshee spirit hovering slightly above the ground in a three-quarter view, a gaunt translucent woman in a long tattered grey-white dress, very long pale silver hair streaming as if underwater, hollow dark eyes, mouth open wide in a keening wail, faint ripples of sound distorting the air around her; a small plain human silhouette stands nearby for scale.

entries.name: 鬼火
entries.summary: 沼泽与荒野夜里的飘浮光点：引诱旅人偏离道路、陷入泥沼。有人说是迷路的亡魂，有人说是妖精的恶作剧。

details.规则: 跟随即迷路；有时也引向宝藏

entries.visual: 幽蓝或淡绿的飘浮光球。

image.brief: A misty moonlit marsh at night with dark reeds, still black water and twisted dead trees, several small floating orbs of pale blue-green light drifting above the water in a winding line leading away into the fog, their reflections shimmering below; no people.

entries.name: 狂猎
entries.summary: 风暴之夜从天空疾驰而过的幽灵骑猎队：猎犬、骑手、号角。看见它的人会被掳走一同奔驰，或预示灾祸。领头者在不同地区是神、妖精王或亡灵君主。

details.讨伐等级: 灾厄（不可讨伐，只能躲避）
details.规则: 冬夜与风暴中出现；闭门、伏地、不回应号角

entries.visual: 暴风云中奔驰的半透明骑手与猎犬。

image.brief: A dark wintry moorland at night under a raging storm sky; across the clouds gallops a spectral procession of translucent pale riders on ghostly horses with antlered helms, horns raised, a pack of glowing-eyed hounds running ahead of them, lightning flickering, a tiny lone cottage with a lit window on the moor below for scale.

entries.name: 水马
entries.summary: 苏格兰河湖中的变形水妖：化作温顺漂亮的马引人骑上，皮毛一沾手就脱不开，随即冲进深水把人淹死。也能化作美貌青年。

details.克制: 套上它的辔头即可驯服；冷铁

entries.visual: 湿漉漉的黑马，鬃毛里缠着水草。

image.brief: A kelpie standing at the edge of a dark loch in a three-quarter side view: a sleek jet-black horse with a dripping wet coat, a long mane tangled with green waterweed and reeds, eyes slightly too bright, hooves partly turned to webbed shapes, droplets falling; a small plain human silhouette stands nearby for scale.

entries.name: 无头骑士
entries.summary: 爱尔兰传说中腋下夹着自己头颅的骑手：在夜里停在谁家门前、喊出谁的名字，谁就会死。
entries.visual: 黑马、黑斗篷、腋下发光的头颅。

image.brief: A headless horseman on a black horse in a three-quarter side view on a misty road at night, a dark high-collared tattered cloak streaming and hiding the neck completely, the rider holding its own pale head under one arm with eyes glowing faintly, the horse's eyes burning dimly; no blood, no wounds visible. A normal-size adult human silhouette stands at the roadside reaching the horse's shoulder.

entries.name: 塞壬
entries.summary: 希腊神话中人首鸟身的海岛歌者：歌声让水手忘却一切、驶向礁石。本库按古典形象做鸟身，与人鱼区分。

details.克制: 蜡封耳、把自己绑在桅杆上

entries.visual: 鸟身、人首、羽翼，栖于礁石。

image.brief: A siren of classical myth perched on the gunwale of a small wooden rowing boat at sea, in a three-quarter side view: the body, wings and taloned feet of a large dark sea bird with a calm beautiful human woman's small head and long hair, mouth open in song, faint ripples of sound over the water; a wooden oar lies across the boat beside her and the whole siren is shorter than the oar's blade and handle together, the size of a large eagle; a plain dark adult human silhouette sits in the boat and is clearly much bigger than the siren.

entries.name: 牛头人
entries.summary: 人身牛首的迷宫之兽：力大无穷、以人为食，被困在迷宫中心。
entries.visual: 健壮人身、公牛头与角。

references.note: 克里特迷宫的弥诺陶洛斯

image.brief: A minotaur standing in a narrow stone labyrinth corridor of rough ancient blocks, in a three-quarter side view: a hugely muscular human body with human legs and bare human feet, the head of a black bull with long curved horns, a bronze ring through its nose, a rough leather kilt, gripping a heavy double-bladed axe; no tail, no hooves; about 2.5 meters tall: the plain dark adult human silhouette beside it reaches its chest.

entries.name: 食人魔
entries.summary: 欧洲童话里的大块头食人怪：贪吃、粗暴、愚笨，住在城堡或林中，被聪明的凡人骗倒。

details.规则: 贪吃与贪财是它的弱点

entries.visual: 肥壮巨大的人形、粗糙皮肤、破旧贵族衣物。

references.note: 《穿靴子的猫》《小拇指》中的食人魔

image.brief: An ogre of European fairy tales standing in a three-quarter side view: a huge fat brutish humanoid with coarse ruddy skin, small greedy eyes, a heavy jaw, wearing a stained oversized nobleman's coat and breeches, a napkin tucked at its collar, holding a gnawed mutton bone; it is about three meters tall: the normal-size adult human silhouette beside it reaches its belly.
